doc: A job registration whose resource header names the second job (FBL 0.10, section 8.2; spec 066, User Story 2, scenario 3): it reads and edits job_b, while job_a's tasks of the same keys are not its. report waits for absent, which names no task, so that dependency is a dangling reference and no relation (section 5.4). Its body, two-jobs-two-pipelines.yml, is etalii.adp.ide.standalone's src/diagrams/databricks/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.Databricks.Tests/Fixtures/two-jobs-two-pipelines.yml at ad1a4680a, byte for byte (CRLF).

steps.doc: Setting run_if on ingest writes into job_b's ingest, the one this reading shows, and not into job_a's task of the same key.

expectFiles.../two-jobs-two-pipelines.yml:
# Two jobs and two pipelines in one file, each reading with a finding of its own.
bundle:
  name: twin_bundle

resources:
  jobs:
    job_a:
      name: Job A
      tasks:
        - task_key: ingest
          job_cluster_key: missing_cluster
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/a_ingest
        - task_key: shape
          depends_on:
            - task_key: ingest
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/a_shape
    job_b:
      name: Job B
      tasks:
        - task_key: ingest
          run_if: ALL_DONE
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/b_ingest
        - task_key: report
          depends_on:
            - task_key: absent
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/b_report
  pipelines:
    pipe_a:
      name: Pipe A
      catalog: main
      schema: bronze
      libraries:
        - notebook:
            path: transformations/a
    pipe_b:
      name: Pipe B
      schema: silver
      libraries:
        - notebook:
            path: transformations/b

targets:
  dev:
    mode: development
  prod:
    mode: production
